extracted.name: Baked Potato
extracted.description: Try this simple baked potato recipe for a spud with crunchy skin and soft, tender flesh, guaranteed every time.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Scrub potato and dry well; prick all over with a fork. Season skin with salt.
Bake directly on the center rack of the preheated oven until easily pierced with a fork, about 1 1/2 hours.
